# terrakube_workspace_variable (Data Source)

Looks up a workspace variable by key within a Terrakube workspace. The same key can exist in more than one category, so set `category` when it does. `value` is null for sensitive variables, and the attribute is always marked sensitive.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "terrakube_organization" "org" {
  name = "my-organization"
}

data "terrakube_workspace" "ws" {
  name         = "my-workspace"
  organization = data.terrakube_organization.org.name
}

# category is only needed when the key exists as both ENV and TERRAFORM.
data "terrakube_workspace_variable" "instance_type" {
  organization_id = data.terrakube_organization.org.id
  workspace_id    = data.terrakube_workspace.ws.id
  key             = "instance_type"
  category        = "TERRAFORM"
}

output "instance_type" {
  value     = data.terrakube_workspace_variable.instance_type.value
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) Variable key
- `organization_id` (String) Terrakube organization ID
- `workspace_id` (String) Terrakube workspace ID

### Optional

- `category` (String) Variable category, ENV or TERRAFORM. Required when the key exists in both.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Variable description
- `hcl` (Boolean) Whether the value is HCL
- `id` (String) Variable ID
- `sensitive` (Boolean) Whether the variable is sensitive
- `value` (String, Sensitive) Variable value. Null when the variable is sensitive.
